xna-type.name: PipelineComponentScanner
xna-type.summary: Implements a scanner object containing the available importers and processors for an application. Designed for internal use only.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of PipelineComponentScanner.

property.name: Errors
property.summary: Gets the list of error messages produced by the last call to Update.

property.name: ImporterAttributes
property.summary: Gets a dictionary that maps importer names to their associated metadata attributes.
property.remarks: Call ImporterAttributes to look up the DisplayName value for an importer object and which file extensions are supported.

property.name: ImporterNames
property.summary: Gets the names of all available importers.

property.name: ImporterOutputTypes
property.summary: Gets a dictionary that maps importer names to the fully qualified name of their return types.

property.name: ProcessorAttributes
property.summary: Gets a dictionary that maps processor names to their associated metadata attributes.
property.remarks: Call ProcessorAttributes to look up the DisplayName value for an processor object.

property.name: ProcessorInputTypes
property.summary: Gets a dictionary that maps processor names to the fully qualified name of supported input types.

property.name: ProcessorNames
property.summary: Gets the names of all available importers.

property.name: ProcessorOutputTypes
property.summary: Gets a dictionary that maps processor names to the fully qualified name of their output types.

property.name: ProcessorParameters
property.summary: This property is available only when developing for Windows.

method.name: Update
method.summary: Updates the scanner object with the latest available assembly states.

overload.summary: This method is available only when developing for Windows.

parameters.parameter: Type: IEnumerable < String > Enumerated list of available assemblies.
Type: IEnumerable < String > Enumerated list of dependent assemblies.

overload.returns: Type: Boolean true if an actual scan was required, indicating the collection contents may have changed. false if no assembly changes were detected since the previous call.
